4247-5254-7741.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
4247-5254-7741.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

4691-4971-6035.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4691-4971-6035.description:
Draw a card.
When you draw a card, Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2 until you have 5 life.
In response to the next trigger, cast Courageous Resolve by paying {2}{W}, giving a creature you control protection from your opponents until end of turn, drawing a card, and preventing yourself from losing the game this turn.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 until your library is empty.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

294-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Iron League Steed.
When Iron League Steed dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Iron League Steed enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
294-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

862-4053-4247-6989.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1308-5478-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
1308-5478-6441-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

215-1849-3291.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-1849-3291.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

740-3417-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
740-3417-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger indestructible using Grand Crescendo.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger.
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
740-3417-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

1170-1329-3518-7220.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lion's Eye Diamond.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Glamermite.
When Glamermite enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1308-1563-3899-5295.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5226-6972-7158.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

486-1978-7066.description:
Cause Avatar Kyoshi to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.
Repeat from step 2.

413-3652-4053-6989.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
When Ornithopter enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

147-413-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Vincent's Limit Break triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

431-1308-2557-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1308-2557-4772.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

719-4338-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Xenograft, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

632-3480-3621-4659-5129.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-3480-3621-4659-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

3054-4050-6255.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-6255.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Zahur triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

759-1247-1660-5963-6549.description:
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' second ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1718-3327-4613-6258.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1718-3327-4613-6258.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1170-1645-2397-4826-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4823-5626-5733.manaNeeded: {5}{U} the first turn, with {7}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
4823-5626-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
You have at least {E}.
4823-5626-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}, sacrificing Timeless Witness, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1018-4377-5626.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} the first turn, with {6}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
1018-4377-5626.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less.
1018-4377-5626.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 3 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Skullwinder, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3276-4968.notablePrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3276-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to Deathbringer Thoctar's deathtouch.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this combo whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

397-1308-3868.notablePrerequisites: You control a Treasure token, and at least one creature.
397-1308-3868.description:
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping the Citizens and another creature, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Stimulus Package twice by sacrificing the Treasures, creating four 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three Citizens, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1825-2499-3634.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
1825-2499-3634.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Treachery by paying {3}{U}{U}, attaching it to Yarok.
When Treachery enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve both Venser triggers, returning it and Treachery from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

539-1339-2232-2459-3848.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven lands.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
539-1339-2232-2459-3848.description:
Cast Rograkh from your hand or the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Omnath's second ability.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on an Elemental you control and drawing a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creture token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-3590-4102.notablePrerequisites:
Psionic Gift attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3590-4102.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Psionic Gift ability by tapping it, choosing any target.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
